columns.comment: Request date of the case (every stage row carries it) - Month = Request Month. "Requests before Feb-2026" = Date < DATE'2026-02-01'. Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never CURRENT_DATE).
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the onboarding request as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the onboarding request, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the onboarding request).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Funnel stage: Request, KYC Docs, Screening, Risk Assessment, Credit/Product Approval, Account Open, First Transaction (activation).
columns.name: Stage

columns.comment: Stage number 1-7 in funnel order (ORDER BY it).
columns.name: Stage Number

columns.comment: Booking location of the case (ISO-2) - every case, including applicants.
columns.name: Booking Country

columns.comment: Segment of the requesting entity (Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance, Public Sector) - "FI clients" = Financial Institution.
columns.name: Request Segment

columns.comment: Case status at 30-Sep-2026: Open, Live, Withdrawn or Rejected.
columns.name: Case Status

columns.comment: Request period vs the Feb-2026 KYC workflow migration: Pre-migration (before Feb-2026), Migration (Feb-2026), Backlog peak (Mar-May 2026), Recovery (from Jun-2026).
columns.name: KYC Migration Period

columns.comment: True for cases requested on or after 1-Feb-2026 ("did it change after February 2026").
columns.name: Is After KYC Migration

columns.comment: True for the stage a case is in now (not exited) - with Case Status = Open, where open cases sit.
columns.name: Is Current Stage

columns.comment: Onboarding cases (counted once, on the stage-1 row).
columns.name: Cases

columns.comment: Cases that went live (counted once).
columns.name: Live Cases

columns.comment: Median calendar days from request to go-live over live cases (exact median, once per case).
columns.name: Median Days to Live

columns.comment: 90th percentile of days from request to go-live over live cases (exact, interpolated).
columns.name: P90 Days to Live

columns.comment: Average days from request to go-live over live cases.
columns.name: Average Days to Live

columns.comment: Average days spent in the stage over completed (exited) stages - group by Stage to see which stage adds the most days.
columns.name: Average Days in Stage

columns.comment: Stage passages completed (exited) in the selection.
columns.name: Stages Completed

columns.comment: Completed stages finished within their SLA days / completed stages (fraction).
columns.name: SLA Met %

columns.comment: Stage passages that ran (or are running) over their SLA.
columns.name: Stages Over SLA

columns.comment: Cases with at least one stage over its SLA.
columns.name: Cases Over SLA

columns.comment: Open cases whose current stage is over its SLA at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Open Cases Over SLA Now

columns.comment: Average days beyond the stage SLA, over stages that ran over.
columns.name: Average Days Over SLA

comment: Onboarding cycle time of SMBC APAC requests, Apr-2024 to Sep-2026: median, P90 and average days from request to go-live (live cases), average days per funnel stage (Request, KYC Docs, Screening, Risk Assessment, Credit/Product Approval, Account Open, First Transaction), SLA met %, stages and cases over SLA, by request month, booking country, segment and the KYC-migration period (Feb-2026 workflow migration; Mar-May 2026 backlog peak). Date = request date. Medians and P90 are exact percentiles over cases, never sums. Grain: one row per onboarding case x stage entered (gold.fact_onboarding_stage_event).
